open_launch_prerequisites.requires: Exact official 81-Duality interpretation bank or verified official implementation, and all task-relevant relationship mappings; unchanged V1 framework is not a substitute.

Explicit disposition of p246 astrology integration. A numerology-only subset must be labeled as such; an overall full-author arm needs a frozen source-faithful operational hybrid adapter and declared chart conventions.
Exact interpretation resources, hierarchy, conditions, source-to-target adapters, complete relevant-layer ledger, input rules and applicable ambiguity decisions; no outcome-selected manifestation.
Source-example and boundary tests plus independent review of the actual operational reading and evaluation code, not merely this design.
Consent, private participant storage, independent event/trait coding, observed-negative protocol, chronology masks and person/relationship-cluster splits.
Primary task/endpoint, meaningful minimum effect, sample-size/precision simulation, thresholds, common coverage, multiplicity and stopping rule before recruitment/unsealing.
Authorized operational release with input/prediction seals, exact reader/toolchain versions and separate outcome access; no launch is authorized by a source audit alone.

completion_boundary: The source audit and this design can be complete while launch prerequisites remain open. No participant study or superiority claim is made.
source_method_vs_project_design: Scoring, sampling, blinding and statistical controls are project research choices, not formulas attributed to the numerology authors.
